parameters.content:
## Seed / bi-weekly full sync
Manual Execute or every other Sunday 03:00 America/Bogota. Pages all MAP issues into Upsert MAP issue bundle. On success, sets map_sync_state.checkpoint to this run's sync_end.

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = "Marketing Activity Plan" ORDER BY issuekey ASC

parameters.content:
## Hourly incremental
Reads map_sync_state, syncs updated >= checkpoint - 5m AND updated < sync_end. Checkpoint advances only after success. Each issue goes through Upsert MAP issue bundle.

nodes.name: Get total MAP tickets in window

attachments.title: :white_check_mark: MAP Jira Sync Completed

parameters.query: SELECT entity_type, checkpoint, status, sync_mode FROM map_sync_state WHERE entity_type = 'issues'

nodes.name: Read MAP issues checkpoint
nodes.notes: Closed-window start. Empty checkpoint falls back to now-minus-2h in the next node. Does not advance on failure.

assignments.name: jql

nodes.name: Build hourly sync window
nodes.notes: JQL uses checkpoint minus 5 minutes through sync_end so clock skew cannot drop rows. Checkpoint itself is only written after the run succeeds.

parameters.query: UPDATE map_sync_state SET last_started_at = NOW(), status = 'running', sync_mode = $1 WHERE entity_type = 'issues' RETURNING entity_type, checkpoint, status, sync_mode, last_started_at
UPDATE map_sync_state SET checkpoint = $1::timestamptz, last_finished_at = NOW(), status = 'success', sync_mode = $2, records_processed = $3 WHERE entity_type = 'issues' RETURNING *

nodes.name: Advance MAP issues checkpoint - Hourly
nodes.notes: Runs only after pagination finishes. Failures never reach this node, so the previous checkpoint is retried next hour.

parameters.query: UPDATE map_sync_state SET checkpoint = $1::timestamptz, last_finished_at = NOW(), status = 'success', sync_mode = $2, records_processed = $3 WHERE entity_type = 'issues' RETURNING *

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger - Bi-weekly full MAP sync

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM map_jira_issues) AS db_issue_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(time_spent), 0) FROM map_jira_issues) AS db_issue_time_spent, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(time_spent_seconds), 0) FROM map_jira_worklogs) AS db_worklog_sum
UPDATE map_sync_state SET jira_issue_count = $1, db_issue_count = $2, db_worklog_sum = $3 WHERE entity_type = 'issues' RETURNING *

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get nightly Jira issue count').item.json.total }},={{ $('Get Guardian MAP counts').item.json.db_issue_count }},={{ $('Get Guardian MAP counts').item.json.db_worklog_sum }}

assignments.name: jql
assignments.value: project = "Marketing Activity Plan" AND updated >= -30d ORDER BY updated ASC

attachments.title: :white_check_mark: MAP Nightly Health OK

parameters.content:
### Bi-weekly full sync
Every other Sunday 03:00 America/Bogota. Same pagination as manual seed. Advances `map_sync_state.checkpoint` only if the run finishes.

### Nightly health
02:00 America/Bogota. Compares Jira issue count and worklog seconds to Guardian. Mismatch recon the last 30 days through the incremental upsert path. Healthy checks do not move the checkpoint.
